text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (My dad is a very gentle person.)

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they gave me too little change... Well, probably not worth making a fuss over.
Anyone can make a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But, Daddy. If the register doesn't balance later,
the clerk will definitely be in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
You're right, they do have to balance the register at the end of the day. Good point, Flower.
I'll go let them know. ...Excuse me, sorry to trouble you, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (He is so gentle that he apologizes even when he did nothing wrong.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (My mom is a very warmhearted horsegirl.)

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
There's still a limited-edition macaron left! Thank goodness.
Flower-chan, let's share it together. Excuse me, I'll take this—

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The limited-edition one is still in stock! I've been looking forward to this ever since I saw it in that magazine...
Ah! S-Sorry. Were you about to buy that...?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, um... Pl-Please, go right ahead. We're still deciding...
...I'm sorry, Flower-chan. Let's pick something else instead.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But Mommy, you said you really wanted to eat that macaron...
Should I tell them we want to buy it?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. She looked like she was looking forward to it much more than me.
Is there anything you'd like to have, Flower-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(She always puts herself last, prioritizing everyone around her first—
that's the kind of horsegirl she is.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Those two gentle, warmhearted people
would sometimes look at me with sad, apologetic faces.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "We're so sorry we're not more dependable."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(That's not true at all. Just being beside them warms my heart all over. So,
I want them to always be smiling, bright and sparkling like the sun.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Is there anything I can do for their sake?
While I was pondering that, one fateful day—)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All the little runners are giving it their absolute best in this exhibition race!
...Oh, wait?! Nishino Flower-chan is surging straight to the front!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Flower... She's looking straight ahead...
With so much... poise and confidence...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... She keeps passing them, one by one...
Without a shred of hesitation, running like that...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Flower! You can do it!!
You've got this, you can win, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now! Burst ahead right there... That's it! Way to go, Flower-chan!!
Go, go!! Don't give up!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
So fast, she's so fast! She broke away from the lead pack in the blink of an eye!
Nishino Flower crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*phew*... Daddy, Mommy, I'm back!
Your cheering surprised me! I've never heard you two yell so loud—

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible! With that tiny body of yours, taking on all those runners—it was magnificent!
Oh, I'm so happy... Daddy is so proud of you...!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! The applause from the crowd was thunderous...!
We couldn't help bragging to everyone, 'That amazing girl is our daughter!'

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run, Flower-chan, it filled me with a sudden surge of confidence.
Seeing our little treasure shining so brightly out there.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly. We found courage through you, Flower.
It made us realize there's no need to shrink back—that we should stand tall with pride.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...My running... did that...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Those two kind, warmhearted people were smiling with sparkling joy.
It was as vivid and bright as the sun shining down on a field of flowers—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! Daddy, Mommy!
I... I want to run more! I want to enter lots and lots of races!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
! Of course, sweetie! We'll support you with everything we've got!
First, we need shoes! We must buy you the best pair! And then...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Let's find a place to train! Somewhere you can run to your heart's content!
We might as well buy a large plot of land and get all the equipment ready...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If my running can make them sparkle, then I want to run more and more and more.
So much that everyone watching shines like the sun, too.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I want to give courage through my races... to turn everyone into sparkling sunshine.
And if that makes Daddy and Mommy smile even more...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —That became my dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How much time had passed since I arrived at the academy as a Trainer?
After the debut selection races, I approached horsegirls who caught my eye—
choice_data_list: If you'd be open to talking...

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I've already decided on someone... Um,
I really want a veteran Trainer, you see...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're a rookie Trainer, right?
I apologize... Maybe if another chance comes along...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it get you down, don't let it get you down!
As long as you don't give up, there's always hope! Keep at it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though rejections were par for the course for a newcomer,
being acutely aware of my own lack of experience and polish made it sting all the more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling dejected, I was wandering through the academy in a daze when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I tripped and fell to the ground.
Looking down at my aching knee only made my mood sink even lower.
A-Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, that looks bad... Can you make it over to that bench?
choice_data_list: I'm fine, don't worry about me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But it looks so painful... Ah, please lean on my shoulder!
Don't worry, I'm an Umamusume after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Constantly checking in on me, she expertly tended to my injury.
Her deft, gentle touch was so soothing I couldn't help but watch in awe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Disinfected and bandaged up nicely.
...Um, how does it feel? Do you think you can walk?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're very welcome! If it still hurts later, please
make sure to visit the infirmary, okay? See you later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The horsegirl who patched me up with a cute floral bandage...
She looked quite young, but she must be a Tracen Academy student as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt a bit embarrassed showing such a pathetic side of myself,
but her kindness brought a touch of healing to my downtrodden heart.
